claim: A 2023 Uzbek press account describes mahalla shop credit in detail: a shopkeeper gave up a rented shop after six months; the same individuals appeared in every neighborhood shop's ledger; one shopkeeper who went to collect recovered roughly a tenth of what was recorded; another burned his ledgers; well-off neighbors also bought on credit; old debts lost value through inflation. Details are from a machine summary of the article and are anecdotal.
